name: v4.7.0
body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 4.6.5._

### Added

- **`audio.py --track FILE`: several audio tracks in one file, each with a name and a language (#420).**
  The input's own sound (`--audio-stream`) and the first audio stream of each `--track` become one audio
  stream apiece after the picture (stream-copied; an audio input writes none), in `.mov`, `.mkv` or `.mp4`.
  Each is written as it is: its own channel layout, rate and length (nothing mixed, resampled, padded or
  trimmed), as 24-bit PCM in `.mov` and `.mkv` and AAC in `.mp4`. `--track-name NAME` (also `--track-title`)
  and `--track-lang CODE` (also `--track-language`) are repeated in track order, the input's sound first;
  a language is an ISO 639-2 code of three lowercase letters. The result's `tracks` lists
  `{index, file, title, language, channels, duration}` read back from the file, a `track_tags` step
  checks the names and languages against it (`.mov` keeps only the languages QuickTime has a code for,
  and says so by failing the step), and a track longer than the picture is kept whole with a
  `track_longer_than_picture` warning. Refused, with `error.reason`: an output that is not
  `.mov`, `.mkv` or `.mp4` (`track_container`; a WAV holds one stream, and FFmpeg's MXF muxer stores no
  names or languages and cuts every track to the shortest), a flag that changes the sound
  (`track_rebuilds_sound`), more titles or languages than tracks (`track_labels`) and a language that is
  not three letters (`track_language`). A BWF or multitrack WAV with a start timecode is not written.
- feat: audio.py --track adds named, language-tagged audio tracks (#420) (#714)



## What's Changed
* feat: audio.py --track adds named, language-tagged audio tracks (#420) by @kajisho5 in https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/pull/714


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/compare/v4.6.5...v4.7.0

body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 4.6.3._

### Fixed

- **On FFmpeg 9 a BT.709 preset over an HDR source wrote conflicting tags (#711).** The encoder's VUI
  said bt709 and the mp4/mov `colr` box said bt2020/smpte2084, because FFmpeg 9 takes the container's
  colour from the frames. The line now relabels the frames' primaries and transfer (`setparams`, no
  pixel changes), so both say bt709. FFmpeg 6.1 to 8 wrote bt709 already and are unchanged.

name: v4.6.3
body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 4.6.2._

### Fixed

- **An HDR or BT.2020 RGB source is converted with the matrix its line is tagged with, and a 10-bit master keeps
  its HDR tags (#559).** `export.py --preset youtube` (and the other 8-bit presets, and `grid.py`) tag BT.709 and
  made such a source's YUV with FFmpeg's BT.601 default: the red C03028 read CE3E26 by its bt709 tag; it is now
  converted with the BT.709 matrix and reads C02E27 (the primaries and transfer are still not converted, and the
  `colour_not_converted` warning still says so). `--preset prores`, `dnxhr-*`, `prores4444`, `prores4444xq`,
  `vp9-alpha` and `graphics.py` / `overlay.py` `--keep-alpha` wrote no colour tag for it (ffprobe:
  unknown/unknown/unknown; the 8-bit DNxHR lines said bt709 over BT.601 pixels): they now carry the source's
  primaries and transfer and bt2020nc, the matrix the picture was converted with, as a YUV source does.
- fix: an HDR RGB source is converted with the matrix its line is tagged with, and a 10-bit line keeps its HDR tags (#559) (#708)

  cache: a run probes each input once.

name: v4.6.0
body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 4.5.3._

### Added

- **`join.py --audio-lead S` (J-cut) and `--audio-lag S` (L-cut) (#675).** With `--transition none`,
  the next clip's sound starts S seconds before its picture (lead), or the previous clip's sound runs
  S seconds past the picture change (lag), at every boundary. Sync is kept, so each boundary costs S
  seconds of a clip: two clips of 8 s and 6 s with S = 0.5 join to 13.5 s. S is whole frames of the
  output rate; the result carries `audio_lead_seconds` / `audio_lag_seconds` and `expected_duration`
  is the shortened length. Refused, with `error.reason`: with a transition, with `--copy`, both
  flags together, and S under a frame or not shorter than a clip. SKILL.md routes "J-cut", "L-cut",
  "cutaway", "cut-in", "reaction cut", "insert" and "smash cut" to their tools;
  `references/requests.md` has the full table of editors' names.
- feat: J-cut and L-cut in join.py (#675) (#701)



## What's Changed
* feat: J-cut and L-cut in join.py (#675) by @kajisho5 in https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/pull/701

name: v4.5.3
body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 4.5.2._

### Fixed

- **`cut.py --segments`, `cut.py --remove` and `silence.py` move the chapters with the ranges they
  keep (#696).** A join of several ranges kept the source's chapters at the source's times, past
  the output's end. Found by the new time guard, not by a report.
- **Any tool that changes the length and leaves chapters behind now says so (#696).** The common
  result writer warns `chapters_not_retimed` when an output of another length carries chapters and
  its tool declared no time map.

### Added

- **Every class of defect fixed three times has a guard that runs every tool (#698).**
  `tests/test_guards.py` runs all the tools (the multi-input ones included) on a 16:9, 5.1,
  chaptered, subtitled clip with stdin left open, and fails on: chapters left at the source's
  times (time), a lost channel or a picture mostly bars or cropped away with nothing said
  (claim), a dry run that reports a measurement, or a record that judges a file it does not name
  (not_measured), the sound before the picture or a result whose first line is not `wrote`
  (surface), a tool that waits on an open stdin (automation). Each was checked by putting the old
  defect back. `docs/defect-guards.json` lists them, and `revert_proof.py` refuses a fix of a
  class with three ledger entries and no guard, so the next class that keeps coming back gets
  one before its fourth fix.
- fix: every class of defect fixed three times has a guard that runs every tool (#700)



## What's Changed
* fix: every class of defect fixed three times has a guard that runs every tool by @kajisho5 in https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/pull/700

body:
_Automated release: version and notes generated from pull requests merged since 4.5.1._

### Fixed

- **A crop that keeps less than half of the picture is said (#688).** `fit.py`, `export.py` and
  `join.py` with `--fit crop` into a frame of the other shape (a 16:9 clip into 9:16 keeps 32%)
  now warn `picture_mostly_cropped` with the fraction kept, as a pad that leaves the picture small
  has since 4.3.4. The file is unchanged.
- **Chapters follow a change of time (#696).** `pad.py --start`, `reverse.py`, `speedramp.py`,
  `freeze.py` and `fit.py --method speed|trim` left a source's chapters at the source's times;
  they are now moved, mirrored or scaled with the picture, clipped to the output, and a chapter
  left with no length is dropped. MP4 and MOV still start their first chapter at 0 (the
  container's chapter track has no gap); Matroska keeps the exact times.
- fix: a crop that keeps less than half of the picture is said, and chapters follow a change of time (#697)

Chat can open Kiro, Auggie and Goose too, and Kiro chats run your own hooks. - 📱 **Do more from your phone:** Answer an agent's questions and Google or Composio setup cards from its chat, review tool approvals and access requests in Needs you, manage an agent's tools and webhooks, start a new chat from +, and browse a group's threads and items. name: v0.9.81
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.81

Released on 2026-11-22.

A heavy page now renders without running out of memory: a render starts only as many browsers as fit. Sealed previews take more edits in place, from moves and crops to undo and hotkeys.

## Fixes

- **Studio:** Studio acts on a sealed preview's key report only after a real press or click ([3ac5265aac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3ac5265aac9fc495244ab077c6b2dc425488c84d), [#8503](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8503)).
- **Core:** A preview of hundreds of clips with no set length no longer loads them all ([d4e8d6f983](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d4e8d6f983aa03ae88dfe99d2ffad1f35cb1d373), [#8303](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8303)).
- **Studio:** Scrubbing across a cut shows the newest frame, not black ([0e6879b8ef](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0e6879b8efea57f588ed835fab56f9211e0cfcde), [#8501](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8501)).
- **Studio:** Copy and duplicate refuse a file that is not one of the project's compositions ([45674e840f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/45674e840f6a3155ba761f7b31330910eba556cc), [#8490](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8490)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview's clips keep their GSAP transition label ([97b90d8fa2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/97b90d8fa2b9e7c475e30e0e9a91f49418d1aedb), [#8499](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8499)).
- **Studio:** A sealed press held across a frame swap starts on the frame shown ([a770f4b85d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a770f4b85dd73e60d7880c630fc3514877d0c611), [#8492](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8492)).
- **Studio:** Paste and duplicate write only allowed markup unless it comes from the same file ([0b73069201](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b73069201b7771078c63c92db0e5b73d99e4dd7), [#8483](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8483)).
- **Studio:** Rotating a layer in a sealed preview turns it from the angle its stylesheet shows ([039eca4f0f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/039eca4f0fa9e12e3a6e1a20386f655f319d89ea), [#8469](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8469)).
- **Studio:** A menu that does not fit below opens above, never over what opened it ([679a5a7e0b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/679a5a7e0b8d6ecc75ac79c3780d814b0d2bb40d), [#8406](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8406)).
- **Studio Server:** A cut names its new half from the file's own id ([fccd00e719](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fccd00e719c5ab8d95baf531248a64ecc6a14a3f), [#8481](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8481)).
- **Ci:** A shard whose results never uploaded is re-run, and never read as an edit accuracy drop ([71588b0a73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/71588b0a73485efc66f00d7abb72e0328547de53), [#8477](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8477)).
- **Studio:** A pasted element lands after its own original, never inside a script ([bfd6cb755f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bfd6cb755f9ea4caface8532c865f9f1ddaa00e6), [#8489](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8489)).
- **Core:** A preview seek waits for each graded video to draw its new frame ([104eab37ad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/104eab37ad38f75336290655e54308d319a4d3e9), [#8488](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8488)).
- **Core:** A far clip the runtime lets go of keeps counting in the film's length ([5ae70826ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5ae70826edba1babb96e57d99be9699c45f0c1d9), [#8480](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8480)).
- **Player:** A sealed film no longer shows failed to load while its runtime starts ([835e660e0e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/835e660e0e3ec98893ef3ace94385d045f790e14), [#8472](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8472)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview shows paused video frames from Studio's decoder ([61008a40dd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/61008a40dd91ca41b70b78757ced98ecf3daa31d), [#8466](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8466)).
- **Studio:** A drag behind a refused edit is refused only when it would land on a clip ([c99cbbe44d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c99cbbe44d92deca1345aac73729fa29828757c9), [#8456](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8456)).
- **Studio:** A sealed Layers pick of a cropped layer puts its resize corners on the whole layer ([f57552da49](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f57552da49c3426e3af641c086fa5cdd25fd595a), [#8468](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8468)).
- **Ci:** A rerun of the captures check reads the PR's current body ([8f7e59742f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8f7e59742f700119875eba1d08d265eae3bd83d0), [#8479](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8479)).
- **Studio:** A sealed move or resize ends its draft in the save's own frame message ([7e26a6d3c0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7e26a6d3c0ac6df0e9cc881b8e3009046ff47015), [#8473](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8473)).
- **Core:** Load the motion path plugin only for a page that tweens along a path ([4157992664](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4157992664d3a9bd456594252fb7a5061ff45c27), [#8449](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8449)).
- **Studio:** A thrown value whose name getter throws still falls back to a reload ([f51e57b26e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f51e57b26ea1526ee3f5a3ce6b3838243b801087), [#8474](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8474)).
- **Engine:** A heavy page starts only as many capture browsers as the machine's memory holds ([969eeba6ee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/969eeba6eea5d04daa50586a62871d2861130513), [#8452](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8452)).
- **Studio:** A timeline edit queued before a project switch stays in its own project ([3e101f9654](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3e101f9654033d73d47ac8a791d0f98c80755226), [#8458](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8458)).
- **Studio:** A sealed crop draws a layer's insets at its own scale and follows a seek ([05d1bc8b1c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/05d1bc8b1c1cbff2fcb447a36da5b5db4e7bad79), [#8451](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8451)).
- **Studio:** An in-place tween patch that throws says why it fell back to a reload ([e98ca56c4a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e98ca56c4abe575b88ca76566e85773cf378438b), [#8454](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8454)).
- **Studio:** A sealed resize keeps a self-centring layer where it is ([926e1b5601](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/926e1b560178651346b18c0dfb105589d61a1419), [#8467](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8467)).
- **Studio:** An undo or redo that adds a sealed page's first edit stays in place ([2d72e523ff](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2d72e523ff3e82e2e840be0daa954480a0bcfe14), [#8462](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8462)).
- **Studio:** Hiding an element hides it in the preview, sealed or not ([d37563e35b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d37563e35be60098c0c87be831ae0ebc921f0b0f), [#8461](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8461)).
- **Studio:** A ripple shift queued behind a refused edit is refused before it writes ([56e0d6fbd7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/56e0d6fbd7fbaa4f668ac940b95089347d1f274e), [#8443](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8443)).
- **Studio:** A reloaded preview shows the saved grade, not one an undo took back ([5e6068e94a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5e6068e94a82d35815611cbecfa8830c3441a348), [#8455](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8455)).
- **Studio:** A sealed canvas pick selects the timeline clip it belongs to ([ff01d81be1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ff01d81be1691c8b97803c6d49d0109367928d20), [#8459](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8459)).
- **Studio:** A key pressed in a sealed preview reaches Studio's hotkeys ([34d5c4678d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/34d5c4678d4fcfdbe21d9185984b6d97577dadce), [#8444](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8444)).
- **CLI:** A crashed or encoder-failed render tells Desktop its code ([678fda62cd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/678fda62cda998f5b117271d8a542f901100cfd1), [#8434](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8434)).
- **Studio:** A preview clip's track is taken only as a whole number ([bf21bf9f78](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bf21bf9f78fca5220fee2e7f4025322efb0c304d), [#8447](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8447)).
- **Studio:** A colour grade made in the property panel saves to the file ([77f3b55fd3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/77f3b55fd3adf09c1579a582eae216c73c6d15be), [#8450](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8450)).
- **Studio:** Moving and nudging an element works in a sealed preview ([eea73b3107](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eea73b3107466de54cd79e4e973e1e5a3c83c2d4), [#8263](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8263)).
- **Share:** Names print as plain text in the terminal, and a saved owner address must be a real address ([d09a1809c1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d09a1809c1eaca2b7da08eb84b47e49eeae95bd2), [#8341](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8341)).
- **Studio:** Timeline clips from the preview keep numeric fields, and drops write them as numbers ([59ea053f10](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/59ea053f1004f730714488b485fe7c98c443adb1), [#8438](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8438)).
- **Studio:** Caption edits save through the project's file writer ([0774d96462](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0774d96462ab3e1145ac5186a3cbba98426f75f0), [#8445](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8445)).
- **Studio:** A preview clip's track, start and length enter the timeline only as numbers ([e1845e5dec](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e1845e5dec6409633cac00937fdd77650ff08085), [#8446](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8446)).
- **Studio:** The topology lens shows in a sealed preview ([79e43a33a8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/79e43a33a87dc3b178c7969c6ceaae7efd33b8b4), [#8420](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8420)).
- **Media Use:** A manifest path naming a share or another root is refused without looking at it ([2a24357338](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a243573389f4410794689d2db526dbf24ba2720), [#8437](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8437)).
- **Studio:** A refused delete also refuses the ripple shifts queued behind it ([925cea1f1f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/925cea1f1f59bfde0d507c3575791f77a775939f), [#8421](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8421)).
- **Studio:** A reload that gives up says whether its frame was missing, blank or unreadable ([8ad7cbae24](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8ad7cbae247661d38638e0b4ae0569288ab1ffa5), [#8419](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8419)).
- **Studio:** Show a sealed composition's clip on the timeline ([28502224a5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/28502224a57631af0894d9a6e2bb6cd9aa9449cd), [#8408](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8408)).
- **Media Use:** Refuse links under .media before reserving, writing or recording ([0495a57f76](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0495a57f764c8b67460db711cf34e509c2860c1d), [#8327](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8327)).

## Docs & Examples

- **README:** Lead with what HyperFrames makes, keep every developer section ([84ff7d71c2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84ff7d71c28798538f33be2009d51dc22fae9794), [#8442](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8442)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** Run the PowerShell round-trip names in one shell so slow Windows runners stay in time ([680c9a5402](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/680c9a5402c5524137763d7ce7ff33dc32589d4e), [#8498](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8498)).
- **CLI:** The doctor output test no longer runs every machine check ([aa262c244d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aa262c244dbe1250356f36fc08d25cfa6c2d15ad), [#8497](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8497)).
- **Studio:** The preview regression runs green against a sealed preview ([3a68f7b3ca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3a68f7b3ca5c2ae99b8cf039b0576f3e457a66d9), [#8470](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8470)).
- **Studio:** The edit-accuracy bench reads what a person ends with after sealed saves and undos ([bc3d7b43e8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bc3d7b43e852c694a5c465a69392dd35b46fe1cd), [#8475](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8475)).
- **Studio:** The preview regression counts decoded covers, not the macOS gamma filter ([154842851a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/154842851acc143bdafa74707992103460369ae7), [#8484](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8484)).
- **Windows:** Run the engine and CLI tests in three shards, not two, to stay under the step deadline ([a638c31aa1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a638c31aa1a0cd44a02019930a0cf506f28bef72), [#8476](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8476)).
- **Studio:** A preview clip's number and track rules live in one place ([deb478a3f6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/deb478a3f630aaf4ba5eeb77b497c7e4be9e8656), [#8471](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8471)).
- **Studio:** Chrome-driven tests run alone after the unit tests ([c731046c77](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c731046c775f484959f33859488bbf98ccbd5dc6), [#8440](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8440)).
- A studio change with no visible effect can say so at any size ([a0b76d20fb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a0b76d20fb687eff5c1036134006a1a618895ea3), [#8439](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8439)).
- **CLI:** A missed late SVG image in snapshot says which wait came up short ([826b4fcc69](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/826b4fcc69f3adf33c068e095504f496f13e48af), [#8435](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8435)).

name: v0.9.80
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.80

Released on 2026-11-22.

Dropping a clip onto main-track clips can now insert it there. Studio previews match the export more closely, and a drive that stops answering no longer stalls a project.

## Features

- **Studio:** Dropping a clip onto main-track clips can insert it there ([08bd7fc12](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/08bd7fc126b1ae158bc9503672acbd88099c9cab), [#8397](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8397)).

## Fixes

- **Engine:** An asset download fails once when the egress proxy drops its tunnel ([da1476e48](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/da1476e48d701d89187f8236ca9f4fc6b9e12158), [#8417](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8417)).
- **Studio:** An insert on drop never lets linked partners overlap or start before 0 ([8929d1164](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8929d116499e10f06622c701ef54d31637c3aef5), [#8416](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8416)).
- **Studio:** A refused delete no longer brings back another delete still saving ([c1f4a193a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c1f4a193a9e3e72776a1433ba72298f5d38237d4), [#8413](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8413)).
- **Engine:** A capture proxy request whose name will not resolve is reported as failed ([75c83d877](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/75c83d87723595b07a058c504efefca1c6be0170), [#8409](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8409)).
- **Studio:** A sealed undo of a GSAP-animated layer's style shows in place ([c3a673990](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c3a67399039ce87adaf2e78d4f7acf6e9a46f20a), [#8320](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8320)).
- **Media Use:** A project manifest's provider claim never writes a sound credit ([ec1839e4a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ec1839e4a17925d9c04dce5bfd5153b4f3ca8a27), [#8410](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8410)).
- **Studio Server:** A file the drive never answers no longer holds a project's first history copy ([267ffc46c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/267ffc46c990e18246f964e8f96bd50a10784707), [#8187](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8187)).
- **Studio:** Fx badges in a sealed preview show the clip's look, crop and duck ([8a69ea039](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8a69ea039594d2eb353b7be40ba5b430c854faec), [#8411](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8411)).
- **Studio:** A paused untagged video shows the colours the export renders ([71907274a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/71907274a7aa0710717db15bec4ec1ab7b7fe8ee), [#8405](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8405)).
- **CLI:** Show copy file names in check progress lines as visible text ([4a5a5eb27](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4a5a5eb27e643a2b9daf3cceab95607c32558324), [#8407](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8407)).
- **Studio:** A delete and its ripple shift save as one edit ([7ec38388b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7ec38388bf9066bdf33d87ac4cd15c63c96068d5), [#8404](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8404)).
- **Studio:** The poster rendered for the next open no longer delays a clip's picture ([da46c89e2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/da46c89e2a0b8d3427cf291b0ee1531d695e74c8), [#8400](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8400)).
- **Studio Server:** A file the drive never answers no longer holds a project's first copy ([71dc6f2fe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/71dc6f2fe1fdbd797ea72c35a420f649ba88a905), [#8403](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8403)).
- **CLI:** The compile cache lives only in the private HyperFrames cache folder ([8127bb885](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8127bb8856d51df14764224c234427d66bbe0642), [#8401](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8401)).

## Internal

- **Engine:** The frame-tag checks get the time a real encode needs ([2b4706f19](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b4706f193c6d42a9bfa630d8f0e009aaa3c4b1d), [#8415](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8415)).

Released on 2026-11-21.

Trimming a main-track clip with Ripple on now closes the gap. Media files that sit outside a project are no longer reused, credited or written through a linked folder.

## Fixes

name: v0.9.78
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.78

Released on 2026-11-21.

Undo after an agent step now brings back the files it changed. A catalog gap report on Windows never puts a query your shell would run into a command, and renders sharing one capture proxy keep their connections.

## Features

- **Engine:** A late image's load time is logged when it arrives ([e65b11e5c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e65b11e5c2be2c73d3ab0ea5628c51ec13f68a21), [#8372](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8372)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Show control characters as text in notices that repeat a failure reason ([c75860ddf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c75860ddf3bf54fb0bd8c21df3ae95efe188f68c), [#8387](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8387)).
- **Core:** A Windows rename onto a folder that exists fails at once instead of waiting 1.3 s ([7cb548e45](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7cb548e45b846683d74dac3c2108fedceb5d146a), [#8389](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8389)).
- **Core:** Show text direction marks and typed text as visible text in printed lines ([f01d1f32b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f01d1f32b093b41adf4233fa1b4ff3a8ff5886cb), [#8384](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8384)).
- **Studio Server:** History keeps undo steps in order when file times and its clock disagree ([63e700de1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/63e700de1ecad6716911251a0b1459c5bec2d35d), [#8383](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8383)).
- **Core:** A long text's name is cut at a word, not inside one ([19587337f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/19587337f61db60da1d7ed6c54d95b021195ac1b), [#8388](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8388)).
- **CLI:** Check reports its own deadlines as check_deadline ([d78e9a5f3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d78e9a5f33fcbc549dd6d78ce4dec9e5be6c4114), [#8378](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8378)).
- **CLI:** Windows kills end only the process the CLI started, never a reused pid ([93f2fcca4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93f2fcca49071184da4d0cc3c8fa095b7d817644), [#8382](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8382)).
- **Player:** Stop the preview reloading itself after a quick seek, and stalling at cuts on a slower connection ([120689e3c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/120689e3c7d13ab8efa9cad5416d162b4723d931), [#8339](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8339)).
- **CLI:** Print check and validate setup commands on their own lines ([88f7d4052](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/88f7d4052dd30ae3e29e1889d68f2231da3d4983), [#8381](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8381)).
- **Studio Server:** The preview file check resolves links on volumes that refuse native realpath ([40cc86252](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/40cc86252d80ebc0daaf3db373b13d339f8c13f8), [#8377](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8377)).
- **CLI:** Print capture setup commands on their own lines ([281f1a2a4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/281f1a2a48137925d114dbd8b55e03d152bdf83d), [#8374](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8374)).
- **Studio Server:** An agent step waits for history's first copies, so undo brings old files back ([fbbf5ee67](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fbbf5ee67e86e41e10536e5088baaf886330a60c), [#8375](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8375)).
- **Studio Server:** History refusals carry a closed reason, so callers tell them from failures ([d5881e8aa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d5881e8aa67f796f851ae15a75702294ef53cc9f), [#8376](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8376)).
- **Studio Server:** A timed-out history save says it may still land, so callers don't retry blindly ([6b74cfa9f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6b74cfa9f5bbf01ebb0fe30420c0dab6c71f4f84), [#8300](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8300)).
- **CLI:** Read --json before the command name the same as after it ([9a618b798](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9a618b798fcb6bb262d3709bc1de6edf2fff974b), [#8365](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8365)).
- **CLI:** Show control characters as text in capture, figma, usage and notice lines ([7fcc4909b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7fcc4909b442ba79918ae69d8a67416820d730f9), [#8366](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8366)).
- **Studio:** Adding or removing a text field keeps the spaces between words ([e8f52dc86](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e8f52dc866221ff8ffad06ce4c198d0d969aaa05), [#8369](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8369)).
- **CLI:** A received-files write waits out a held lock instead of failing on Windows ([f74e1545c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f74e1545c06e32b5f0c0722b4a46b7e628d04a31), [#8367](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8367)).
- **CLI:** A stop reads the process tree from /proc on Linux, so load cannot hide a child ([a2df08e49](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a2df08e49ebb2b2d285c0e8a7c173f953b032a9d), [#8363](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8363)).
- **Engine:** A capture proxy shared by many browsers no longer drops tunnels at 128 ([5e16c18b1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5e16c18b1d239f7e1225f59be5c44614a6d9d784), [#8362](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8362)).
- **CLI:** Show control characters as text in init, skills and render printed lines ([8bc73a0bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8bc73a0bd34313790bdbf6be43cf67f311800711), [#8352](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8352)).
- **CLI:** Show control characters as text in more commands' printed lines ([7a1163fc9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7a1163fc98149719c636a170aad6c99e2d68a291), [#8353](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8353)).
- **Studio Server:** A preview file request no longer waits on a silent drive on the event loop ([7cb605c78](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7cb605c787f4e85f66a2a46df60f8fdbe13faad6), [#8254](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8254)).

## Catalog

- **CLI:** A catalog gap report hands back a line only when every shell reads the query as text ([414557262](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4145572625110706fdbc269adaca70ee5de531e8), [#8373](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8373)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** The probe-cache snapshot test asks 16 times of an 8 s clip, not 40 of 20 s ([c7a6c9315](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c7a6c9315bf1237bce715471cde268b32a21bb0b), [#8390](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8390)).
- **Lint:** Linear scans are held to characters read and one coarse time bound ([e0d844030](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e0d84403096c7b4d77c55448087251e9ffd3f44a), [#8386](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8386)).
- **Studio:** The marquee-past-the-cap check waits as long as the frame takes to answer ([b0d9f3615](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b0d9f3615984e6e88c2d6b4dae862fbde2004da1), [#7757](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7757)).
- **Studio Server:** A held-file edit is checked for blocking waits, not wall-clock gaps ([29a5003ee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/29a5003eebdd1a1a01e4d1a4e3f375da93b078ab), [#8236](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8236)).
- **Studio Server:** A held save proves it never sleeps the thread, not a 100 ms stall bound ([ba81f6793](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ba81f67930cce689b1444c03dc3a4c0dbf13e97b), [#8359](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8359)).

## Other Changes

- **CLI:** The proxy fix and its Node.js 22.19 floor came out again before this release; they ship in v0.10.0 ([296031974](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/29603197498c32d37f76a5de07498fc555fa515b), [#8311](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8311), [66156bf35](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/66156bf35ebecfe0075d3d01405773ab2792a6f0), [#8391](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8391)).

## Full changelog

name: Chromium v156.0.8078.47.8 — Stealth Build (Pro)
body:
## CloakBrowser Pro: Stable advances to Chromium 156.0.8078.47.8 (Linux) and 156.0.8078.47.7 (Windows)

Chromium `156.0.8078.47.8` is now Stable on **Linux** (x64 and ARM64), and `156.0.8078.47.7` on **Windows** (x64). macOS Stable stays on `156.0.8078.47.1`.

With a valid CloakBrowser key, the wrapper automatically selects the Stable build for your platform. No version pin is required.

### What's new since 156.0.8078.47.1

- **Challenge pages stuck on "Verifying…" pass more reliably.** On sync Python, update the wrapper to `0.7.3` too.
- **Canvas tuned for Chromium 156.** Chrome 156 changed how canvas renders, and our results now match real 156 machines, including on Linux servers without a GPU.
- **Image editing and upload pages work as in stock Chrome.**
- **More consistent personas.** Every place a site reads your persona from now agrees, at any zoom, including on ARM servers.
- **More stock Chrome 156 behavior restored**, like payments, built-in AI, page unload, and browser error messages. The Windows persona also plays protected video, like Chrome on Windows 11.
- **Closer to Google Chrome on Google services** with `--fingerprint-allow-3p-cookies`.
- **Better fonts for non-Latin languages** on the Windows and macOS personas.
- **WebRTC calls and peer connections** connect as in stock Chrome.
- **Windows open where you ask.** Popups opened at a position, `moveTo()`, and `--window-size` windows report their real position, and on Linux the window fills the screen's usable area.
- **More realistic performance.** Page timing follows stock Chrome more closely (Linux).
- **Several languages in one locale:** `--fingerprint-locale=en-US,el-GR` gives you English pages while the browser still shows a second language.
- **Transparent proxy mode is steadier:** fewer license hiccups, with backup DNS servers.

Your profiles, cookies, and seeds are untouched. Only the browser itself is replaced.

### Current wrapper: v0.7.3

Update the wrapper before launching:

```bash
pip install -U cloakbrowser
npm update cloakbrowser
dotnet add package CloakBrowser --version 0.7.3
```

### Roll back if needed

If a workload regresses, pin the previous Stable build:

```bash
export CLOAKBROWSER_VERSION=156.0.8078.47.1   # Linux, Windows
```

Remove the pin to return to the newest Stable build.

**If you hit a regression, please tell us.** [Open an issue](https://github.com/CloakHQ/CloakBrowser/issues) or email support@cloakbrowser.dev with the site and what you saw. Pinning the old build gets you unblocked; a report gets it fixed for everyone.

### Checksums (SHA-256)

```text
version=156.0.8078.47.8
0ac3bf0c64b09503f433d5d05ec920cb4ca6c3b2342474dab273297a093ecccc  cloakbrowser-linux-x64.tar.gz
ade92ae9254320687b7361044612bf11612425265d5166f51cea8c78b238d94f  cloakbrowser-linux-arm64.tar.gz
```

```text
version=156.0.8078.47.7
6f8ac2665b34d9a4fd20fc2fcc608206e1f46f8f8ce2036005bad629ba8b0af9  cloakbrowser-windows-x64.zip
```

The signed manifests are attached (`SHA256SUMS` + `SHA256SUMS.sig` for 47.8, `SHA256SUMS-156.0.8078.47.7` + `.sig` for 47.7). The wrapper verifies the Ed25519 signature and each archive's SHA-256 checksum automatically.

## What's in v0.10.3


Codewhale v0.10.3 brings a unified Plugins surface with Creator mode (`[features] plugin_creator`) and unmodified DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`) plugin compatibility, an upgraded Auto-Review guardian with workspace boundaries, soft rules, sub-agent return review, and one-use retry approvals, and a single `Shift+Tab` permission dial defaulting to Accept Edits (`Ask → Accept Edits → Plan → Auto-Review → Full Access`). It moves the ACP server and external-agent sessions (including Qwen Code and GitHub Copilot CLI) onto the official Agent Client Protocol SDK, publishes native signed HarmonyOS ARM64 release assets, adds a verified signed model-and-provider registry channel alongside unified model-ID resolution and managed `/v1/models` pricing, updates design tokens to `5.4.0` with a docked single-line approval strip, folded turn activity, live working-row light sweeps and 13 hex-lattice dot-whale forms, adds `claude-org` billing auth, `show_data` transcript charts, `codewhale sessions migrate`, DeepSeek Chatbot web search and speech tools, receipted self-updates and `codewhale uninstall`, and lands reliability, CJK/Unicode, Windows, and sandbox security fixes.

## Install

### Recommended — official GitHub release

New macOS/Linux install (checksummed binaries from this release):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://codewhale.net/install.sh | CODEWHALE_VERSION="v0.10.3" sh
"$HOME/.local/bin/codewhale" --version
```

For Windows, use the matching installer or archive below. For an existing
direct install, run `codewhale update`; it prints the executable path and
keeps newer builds. If the install directory is occupied by a different build,
use the fresh-directory migration in [the installation guide](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md).

### Secondary packaging — npm and Cargo

```bash
npm install -g codewhale
# or build from source
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The wrapper downloads the matched `codewhale` and `codew` command assets
from this Release. Both contain the same compiled runtime.

### Docker / GHCR

```bash
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \
  -v codewhale-home:/home/codewhale/.codewhale \
  ghcr.io/codewhale-hq/codewhale:v0.10.3
```

The image exposes the same runtime as both `codewhale` and `codew`. The
`latest` tag is also updated on release.

### Cargo (Linux / macOS)

```bash
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The Cargo package installs `codewhale`. Cargo cannot create a second command
alias from one binary target; users who want the shorter spelling can add a
`codew` symlink to that installed executable. The npm, Homebrew, archive,
shell-installer, and container channels install both command names directly.

### Manual download — platform archives (recommended)

Each archive below contains the same runtime under the `codewhale` and
`codew` command names, plus an install script:

| Platform | Archive | Install script |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x64 | `codewhale-linux-x64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Linux ARM64 | `codewhale-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Android ARM64 (Termux) | `codewhale-android-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| HarmonyOS ARM64 (native) | `codewhale-ohos-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| macOS x64 | `codewhale-macos-x64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| macOS ARM | `codewhale-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Windows x64 (installer) | `CodeWhaleSetup.exe` | NSIS setup |
| Windows x64 | `codewhale-windows-x64.zip` | `install.bat` |
| Windows x64 (portable) | `codewhale-windows-x64-portable.zip` | — |
| Windows ARM64 | `codewhale-windows-arm64.zip` | `install.bat` |
| Windows ARM64 (portable) | `codewhale-windows-arm64-portable.zip` | — |

**Unix (Linux / macOS):**
```bash
tar xzf codewhale-<platform>.tar.gz
cd codewhale-<platform>
./install.sh
```

**Windows:**
- For the installer path, run `CodeWhaleSetup.exe`; it installs
  `codewhale.exe`, `codew.exe`, and `codewhale.bat` under
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CodeWhale\bin`, adds that directory to the
  current-user PATH, and creates a Start Menu shortcut that prefers
  Windows Terminal (`wt.exe`) when it is installed.
- Extract the archive for your machine: `codewhale-windows-x64.zip` or
  `codewhale-windows-arm64.zip`
- Double-click `codewhale.bat` (not the raw `.exe`) to launch
- Run `install.bat` to copy the binaries and launcher to `%USERPROFILE%\bin`
- Add `%USERPROFILE%\bin` to your PATH

The **portable** Windows archive skips the install script — extract and run `codewhale.bat` from any directory. The NSIS installer is currently unsigned and may trigger Windows SmartScreen until a signing certificate is wired into the release pipeline.

Each platform also has **bare, unarchived** `codewhale-<platform>` and
`codew-<platform>` assets. The seven `codewhale-tui-<platform>` filenames
attached to v0.9.5 are byte-identical compatibility copies used only to let
already-installed v0.9.4 clients discover and cross this single-binary
transition; current installers do not expose a third runtime. The legacy npm
package `deepseek-tui` is deprecated and is not republished. For migration
from v0.8.x legacy binary names, see `docs/REBRAND.md`.

### Verify (recommended)

Download the checksum manifests from this Release and verify:

```bash
# Linux — archive bundles
sha256sum -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# Linux — individual binaries
sha256sum -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# macOS
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing
```

Matched brace and nested-directory globs in `grep_files` ([#7215](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7215)). Kept the draft when the command palette inserts a command ([#7205](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7205)). Bounded nested brace expansion and repeated globstars in `grep_files` ([#7254](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7254)) and kept a typed draft when a failed send comes back ([#7255](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7255)), restored context percentages after session loads ([#7256](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7256)), preserved untouched characters on fuzzy edits ([#7257](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7257)), recognized `@` mentions after CJK text and repeated file ranges ([#7258](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7258), [#7259](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7259)), accepted full-width spaces and newlines after custom commands ([#7260](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7260)), aligned `/config` detail values across locales ([#7267](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7267)), and kept Markdown character references literal in code and argv ([#7192](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7192)).

Capped WeCom reply chunks by UTF-8 bytes ([#7209](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7209)). Accepted media and voice messages on the WeCom bridge ([#7212](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7212)). Steered a running turn from the WeCom bridge ([#7211](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7211)). Surfaced WeCom API error details in bridge replies ([#7208](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7208)) and rotated WeCom stream replies before the ten-minute expiry ([#7210](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7210)); both were harvested with the original commits kept. Stopped provider timeouts reporting "after 0ns" ([#7253](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7253)), exposed read-only `/system`, `/tokens` and `/cost` builtins over the Runtime API ([#7277](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7277)), and carried reviewed session memory and hygiene guidance into sub-agents ([#7359](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7359)).

- **[Sh1Zuku / @SparkofSpike](https://github.com/SparkofSpike)** — resolved a relocated state root before session-side state opens ([#7097](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7097)) and made a goal pause to ask instead of inventing the answer ([#7175](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7175)), and gave the model a way back into the transcript compaction replaced ([#7173](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7173)). Added the bare DeepSeek V4.1 Flash catalog entry ([#7183](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7183)). - **[@laozidabo](https://github.com/laozidabo)** — localized `/diff` feedback ([#7101](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7101)), flushed queued saves before signal exit ([#7122](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7122)) and kept `/rc` start failures visible ([#7127](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7127)), logged redacted provider failure causes ([#7353](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7353)), stopped named-turn undo from rereading the session history ([#7362](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7362)), and rolled back partial file-scoped undo restores from the safety snapshot ([#7366](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7366)).

- **[@vshulcz](https://github.com/vshulcz)** — documented a hybrid Claude bundle that installs declaratively with `/plugin install` and keeps its lifecycle hooks in `config.toml` ([#7346](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7346)).
- **[@deosiree](https://github.com/deosiree)** — bounded the terminal's wait for the session snapshot at turn end so a newly started turn no longer freezes the UI, and exposed request transmission in terminal provider errors ([#7360](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7360), [#7448](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/pull/7448)).
- **[@ruanchaves](https://github.com/ruanchaves)** — kept MCP tools whose optional parameters carry a Pydantic `default: null` in Moonshot (Kimi) requests instead of dropping them ([#7364](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7364)).

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for full notes and [docs/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/blob/main/docs/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) for older releases.

name: Caveman 4.2.0
body:
Caveman 4.2.0 adds a QuickJS Code-Mode MCP gateway (`caveman codemode` / `caveman wrap --codemode`) with multi-agent overlays, multi-harness tool-envelope unwrapping in the compression engine, cache-safe proxy optimizations (local turn-effort gating, duplicate-read collapsing, canonical tool ordering, and `defer_loading`), `@caveman-ai/middleware/codemode`, opt-in Code-Mode support in `@caveman-ai/pi` 0.4.0, and a native Codex CLI provider for `caveman-compress`.

### New

**QuickJS Code-Mode MCP gateway** (#1559)
- **`caveman-mcp codemode` and `caveman codemode`** collapse large upstream stdio and HTTP MCP catalogs into a static, prefix-cache-safe set of Code-Mode tools (`codemode_search_tools`, `codemode_execute`, `codemode_mutate`) backed by an embedded pure-Go QuickJS sandbox (`modernc.org/quickjs`) plus built-in repo and PR helpers (`batch_read`, `symbol_outline`, `pr_read`, `ci_logs`).
- **`caveman wrap --codemode`** installs temporary per-session Code-Mode overlays for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Kilo, OpenClaw, Pi, and Hermes (including `config.yaml` sync-back of in-session Hermes edits; Cursor MCP configs are discovered by `caveman codemode`).
- **Workspace MCP discovery is explicit:** workspace-local MCP definitions are loaded only when `--trust-workspace-mcp` or `CAVEMAN_TRUST_WORKSPACE_MCP=1` is set.
- **Exact recovery and non-text fidelity:** Code-Mode execution outputs and built-in tools store originals in CCR before elision; upstream HTTP and stdio MCP decoding preserves integers above `2^53` and non-text attachment blocks (images, audio, resources), streams HTTP SSE replies incrementally, and strips auth/custom headers across cross-origin redirects.

**Cache-safe proxy optimizations** (#1559)
- **`--turn-effort`** applies cache-safe per-turn effort gating across Anthropic (including Opus 4.7 / adaptive reasoning models), OpenAI/Codex, and Gemini without breaking prefix caches, replaying Codex/ChatGPT effort marks across substantive turns.
- **Duplicate-read collapsing**, **canonical `tools[]` ordering (`--canonical-tools`)**, **MCP tool deferral (`--defer-mcp-tools`)**, and **tool catalog shrinking (`--shrink-tools`)** keep provider prompt prefixes byte-stable while trimming redundant input context. MCP-disabled streaming OpenAI Responses requests remain byte-identical.

**Multi-harness engine envelopes** (#1559)
- The compression engine unwraps tool-result envelopes emitted by Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Hermes so code, search results, and test reports compress cleanly across harnesses while preserving Go build and setup failure diagnostics in verbose `go test` output.

**Framework middleware and Pi** (#1559)
- **`@caveman-ai/middleware` 1.2.0** adds `@caveman-ai/middleware/codemode` (`createCodeModeToolset`), a zero-dependency in-process Code-Mode toolset with BM25 discovery, structured pipelines, and read/write separation.
- **`@caveman-ai/pi` 0.4.0** adds opt-in Code-Mode tools (`CAVEMAN_PI_CODEMODE=1`) backed by a lazy `CodemodeClient`, honors `CAVEMAN_MCP_PREFIX_ARGS`, and extends RPC timeouts past caller script deadlines.

**caveman-compress**
- Native Codex CLI provider for `caveman-compress`, isolated from local tools (#1427 by @danez).

### Fixed

- **Engine and proxy:** guard `unwrapFileWrapper` against whitespace-only input; recover per segment so an engine panic fails open while still re-raising `http.ErrAbortHandler` (#1518).
- **OpenCode:** preserve whitespace in configured `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` (#1518).
- **CLI:** remove stale `dev` and `deploy aws` commands that referenced removed targets.
- **Python SDK:** restore the TLS byte budget after HTTP `CONNECT` reads (#1502).

### Maintenance

- Go toolchain bumped to Go 1.26.11 (#1532).
- Documentation consolidated around `AGENTS.md` and `docs/WHY.md`, with public benchmark sample sizes stated alongside published figures.
- Binaries: `bin-v4.2.0`. CLI: `@caveman-ai/cli` 4.2.0. Middleware: `@caveman-ai/middleware` 1.2.0. Pi: `@caveman-ai/pi` 0.4.0.

name: @caveman-ai/middleware 1.2.0

name: v5.1.81
body:
### Changed

- The `programming` skill's language gate now routes rendered web work (`.html`, `.css`, `.jsx`, `.tsx`, `.vue`, `.svelte`, `.astro`, or any task that ships a UI) to the `frontend` skill before the first line of UI code. It tells the agent to take the look from the frontend skill's references when there is no design direction (no named brand, reference, `DESIGN.md`, or existing styled UI to match), and to finish only after `visual-qa` passes on the rendered surface. ([#14604](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14604), fixes [#14602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14602))

### Fixed

- Memory sync: a sign-out now retires the trust pin of the account it signs out of, so `omo account show --account <id>` no longer answers `joined` once that sign-in's keys are gone. Plain `omo account forget` (the desktop's sign-out of a CLI-item session) used to retire nothing. It now reads the stored sign-in first to find its account. A stored sign-in that cannot be read is still deleted and its pin is left; one warning line is printed only after the delete succeeds. A forget that fails on a locked store reports only that error (#12308, #12384). ([#13642](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13642)) ([#14533](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14533))
- Memory sync: some sign-ins earned their pin before `omo sync` recorded their account. On a refused refresh, plain `forget`, `forget --device` and `adopt --replace`, omo now asks the service for that account, as `omo logout` already did, and retires the pin when the service names it. It asks only while a live pin exists and the access token has not expired; on a refused refresh, the token may still be valid in the 30 s before expiry, when the refresh runs. An expired token is never sent. A pin whose account stays unknown is kept, and omo prints one line naming `omo account retire-sync --account <id>` to clear it, because `omo account show` keeps answering `joined` for it (#12383, #13662). ([#13642](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13642)) ([#14533](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14533))

### Added

- `omo sync status` (and `--json`) shows this device's memory sync state: the signed-in account, whether this device has joined and whether its sync switch is on, the account's devices with their sync membership and last-seen time, pending join requests, and whether an engine is running on this machine. It writes no sync state, prints no key material, and each section reports its own failure instead of failing the command. ([#14437](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14437), fixes [#14435](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14435)) ([#14533](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14533))

name: CC Switch v4.0.39
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.39

本版本以修复为主。**API Key 输入框**加了复制按钮；**备份**可以设置总大小上限，超过时从最旧的开始删；Claude Code 经 Codex OAuth 使用 **GPT-6.2 Sol / Astra** 时，系统提示的缓存命中率大幅提高。

另外修复了 Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 的原生供应商卡住不出字时，要等最长 600 秒才故障转移；很长的流式响应让用量和日志收集占用的内存一直增长；一键导入链接合并配置失败后仍弹出确认框；只装了 Codex 桌面版时，插件页显示「未安装 Codex」；插件页给没装的应用建了空配置文件夹；OpenCode Go 的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 缺少 `max` 思考档位；快速点击时弹出层和下拉菜单闪烁等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.39-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.39-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### API Key 输入框可以一键复制

供应商表单的 API Key 输入框旁边多了复制按钮（[#9232](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9232)），复制的是去掉首尾空格后的 Key，成功或失败都会提示。输入框为空或不可编辑时不显示。

### 备份总大小上限

备份设置里新增「备份总大小上限」（[#9011](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9011)，相关 [#6706](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6706)），默认「不限制」，升级后不会删任何备份。

- 设置上限后，备份文件夹超过这个大小时，会从最旧的备份开始删除。
- 最新的一份备份和恢复正在使用的备份始终保留，所以单份备份比上限还大时，文件夹仍可能超过上限。
- 上限在下次备份或每日维护时生效。每日维护还会清理备份中途崩溃留下、超过 24 小时的临时文件。

---

## 变更

- **Claude Code 经 Codex OAuth 使用 GPT-6.2 Sol / Astra 时缓存命中率更高**（[#9848](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9848)，见 [#9847](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9847)）：系统提示改放在第一条 developer 消息里，ChatGPT 后端会把它和对话一起缓存。实测从第二轮起命中率约 98%。其他模型和用 API Key 的路由不变。
- **隐私过滤器更快**（[#9826](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9826)）：过滤结果不变。

---

## 修复

- **Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 的原生供应商卡住不出字时，最长要等 600 秒才故障转移**（[#9754](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9754)）：这类流式请求用的是非流式请求的超时，现在和其他流式请求一样用首字超时（默认 60 秒）。
- **很长或一直不结束的流式响应，让用量和日志收集占用的内存一直增长**（[#9846](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9846)，见 [#9843](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9843)）：缓冲现在最多 64 MiB，遇到超大的事件后也能继续解析后面的内容。
- **一键导入链接合并配置失败后，仍弹出确认框**（[#9844](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9844)，见 [#9841](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9841)）：现在只提示错误，不再弹确认框。
- **只装了 Codex 桌面版时，插件页显示「未安装 Codex」**（见 [#9850](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9850)）：比如 Windows 上只装了 Codex 桌面版（MSIX）。现在找不到单独安装的 `codex` 时，插件页等用到 Codex 命令行的地方会改用桌面版自带的那份。「应用」页的安装、升级和卸载仍只管单独安装的 Codex CLI。
- **插件页给没装的应用建了空配置文件夹**（见 [#9852](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9852)）：打开插件页时，没装 Codex、Grok Build、OpenClaw、Pi 或 MiniMax Code 也会建出 `~/.codex`、`~/.grok` 等空文件夹。现在找到命令行工具后才建，没装的照常显示「未安装」。
- **OpenCode Go 的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 缺少 `max` 思考档位**（见 [#9853](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9853)）：预设现在按 OpenCode Go 的模型列表写明 `low`、`high`、`max` 三档，OpenCode 不再退回通用的 `low` / `medium` / `high`。
- **快速点击时，弹出层和下拉菜单闪烁**（[#9176](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9176)，见 [#9175](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9175)）：在打开或关闭的动画过程中再点一下，不会再连着切换两次。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @H15teve（GPT-6.2 缓存命中）、@minimote（复制 API Key）、@zayokami（备份总大小上限）、@vastStage（流式请求超时）、@HaiYangBG1（流式响应内存、一键导入失败提示、测试隔离）、@YUZHEthefool（隐私过滤器提速）、@Delta1035（弹出层闪烁）、@allenxu09（评审修改）、@SaladDay（代码整理）的贡献。

感谢 @IndexEeve、@Thanatos-Z、@beiqixingnang、@muchenkezhan 报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: Niubash v1.5.1
body:
### Fixed

- **Deep-audit host fix wave (1.5.1-bound, 2026-11-04)**: seven non-interactive host findings fixed (#886) — including corrupt plugin-spec errors now naming the file and the cause; `$BASH_ARGV0` seed no longer clobbered by host startup and `NIU_COMP_WORDS` no longer duplicated (#887, with the engine-side compspec fixes in rubash #2756); frozen interactive config specs (`NIU_BINDKEYS`/`NIU_COMPDEFS`) re-applied on setup re-run (#891, closing #889/#890). The remaining host finding (#888, exported HISTFILE) is a recorded owner decision. Engine-side counterparts landed in rubash's deep-audit wave (see the rubash changelog).
- **Windows interactive login shells read `~/.niubashrc` again** (niubash#1057): `--login`/`-l` (and the argv[0] `-` seed) no longer divert the interactive startup face onto the GNU profile chain — `niu --login -i` now sources the generated plugin loader and `~/.niubashrc` exactly like `niu -i` (`--rcfile` and `NIU_RC_POLICY` apply unchanged), restoring the standing contract "Windows accepts the flags with unchanged behavior (no login concept)". GNU shell.c:1833's "the login profile chain replaces the interactive-RC alternative" is a deliberate product fork on this face, not a GNU-alignment gap: on a bare Windows home none of the chain's files exists, so `--login -i` used to source nothing at all. Deliberate side effects: ① a staged GNU profile file (`.bash_profile`/`.bash_login`/`.profile`) no longer runs on the Windows interactive face; ② the #590 expectation flips on Windows — an interactive login shell loads loader + rc and no chain; ③ the non-interactive `-c` face is unchanged — `-l -c` still sources the GNU chain (niubash#399/#587/#602) — and POSIX mode keeps the chain on every platform.
- **Engine and bundled-commands line rises to 1.5.1**: the rubash pin takes rubash master `649b3be3` (v1.5.1 — the 703-issue GNU Bash 5.3.20 differential wave, see the rubash changelog), the ruline pin takes ruline main `4d0aefa8`, and the bundled WinuxCmd line is 1.2.2. Also in this wave: bind -x conhost chord dispatch and READLINE_POINT restore (#1065, closing #1063) and the env.exe distribution fix through the winuxcmd bundle (#1062).

### Full list

All 72 issues closed in the window (2026-11-03 – 11-22), grouped by theme (mechanical classification, one group per issue; titles verbatim):

#### Completion (13)

- #830 has_compspec probe uses first whitespace token of the whole line — compspec silently bypassed on multi-command lines
- #831 library Shell::completion_probe diverges from the REPL — no bridge, no compdefs, empty state on one-shot shells
- #832 menu_open stand-down flag wired to only 2 of 6 completion menus — hinter paints over menus and Right accepts the ghost instead of navigating
- #833 poisoned completion_state lock silently freezes the completion snapshot forever; other lock poisonings go stale or respawn per-TAB
- #836 compdef_suggestions runs ahead of the compspec gate and merges into compspec-owned commands
- #838 $ alone completes nothing — variable completer bails on the bare prefix
- #840 state.behavior is write-once — mid-session NIU_COMPLETION_* changes never reach the completer
- #841 residue sweep: WINSH_ env var + ~/.winsh cache dir on the live completion path
- #845 completion cache keys omit inputs — stale values served across args, dirs, TTLs, and binary upgrades
- #849 setup re-apply re-sources the rc but never re-reads NIU_BINDKEYS/NIU_COMPDEFS — wizard-added declarations silently inert
- #851 staleness/quoting batch — exec_verdicts chmod-blind, effective_flags wrong token, compdef ignores match mode, pending-input drops non-ASCII, vi maps lose GNU C-x chords
- #918 [bug] Windows drive-letter words fail through complete_detailed under default COMP_WORDBREAKS (colon split strips the drive)
- #973 [plugin] complete-alias fixture entry unreachable: extension-less entry files are not enumerated as enable-able assets

#### Interactive editing & display (6)

- #731 [feature] K3 翻译扩围（承 #630 余项）：分类器扩围 + redraw-current-line + quoted-insert 投递臂
- #866 缩窗后编辑态 prompt 换行堆叠重印：resize→repaint 未原地重绘（niubash-runtime 共享层，1.4.4 与 master 同现）
- #882 [interactive] Per-keystroke FULL prompt repaint (erase-down + re-render) relies on Sync-2026 — terminals without it flicker on every key
- #927 [repl] TAB on an empty-word buffer inserts a literal tab instead of completing
- #974 [bug] unix 关标签页（SIGHUP + PTY 主端关闭）会话挂死不退出，整会话历史与 EXIT trap 丢失
- #985 run_repl_without_line_editor 降级回路：阻塞 stdin 读不被 SIGHUP 门铃唤醒，未 trap 形得 129 而非信号死

#### Keybindings & widgets (9)

- #834 dropped-binding coverage gaps — chord-layer drops, unknown -m keymaps, bundle widget binds, and NotSentinel all vanish without a registry record
- #835 menu-complete-backward missing from native_widget_event — binds to a dead key via widget paths
- #844 \xHH macro escapes decode byte-as-char — non-ASCII bind/macro text double-encodes into mojibake
- #848 plugin chords silently lose to GNU defaults and engine chords — Script-layer precedence inverted in ChordIndex
- #850 host-side ruline mappings wrong — yank → PasteCutBufferBefore kills yank-pop; exchange-point-and-mark → wrong EditCommand; insert-comment missing GNU '# '
- #961 repl：BindingSpec::Keymap 显式臂替换通配臂（rubash #3013 宿主半）
- #977 Ctrl-C 在 bind -x widget 执行之后不弃行（普通提示符下正常）
- #1047 [ledger] api-ledger §6 dropped the BindKindView::Keymap variant row (next rubash canary will trip)
- #1063 bind -x 在 Windows/conhost 上按键不触发，且 widget 内 READLINE_LINE/READLINE_POINT 为空

#### Startup & configuration (6)

- #846 NIU_* env channels orphaned or startup-only — prompt segments permanently empty, interactive export silently ignored
- #947 Segments prompt backend is unreachable in the shipped product: no config/env/rc/CLI path selects prompt_style "segments"
- #954 Interactive startup never sources the default ~/.bashrc (only --rcfile works)
- #1001 [bug] 环境变量值里的 POSIX 路径原样泄漏给原生 exe：FOO=/d/x cmd/python 收到 /d/x（参数位有转换、env 值没有）
- #1006 build: Linux-host cross build to x86_64-pc-windows-gnu cannot embed the niu.exe icon (build.rs wants rc.exe/llvm-rc.exe and an MSVC .res GNU ld rejects)
- #1057 [bug][Windows] `--login` skips `~/.niubashrc` and falls back to the GNU profile chain

#### Plugins (4)

- #843 small staleness/diagnostic gaps batch — history-error collapse, stale-dir fallback, state_path cwd leak, preset silence, plugin unbind reach, dead expand loop, layer misattribution
- #852 fail-quiet/leak batch — unix paste-protection gap, git scratch silent None, plugin loader unreadable≡absent, preserve_std_handles partial failure, terminal size fallback
- #889 [A4-08] Plugin source registry accepts duplicate ids; remove deletes one record at a time
- #968 plugin enable cannot see extension-less entry files of path-added (wild) sources

#### History (5)

- #888 [A4-02] Exported HISTFILE is ignored as the REPL backing file (decision: seed vs #571/#661 doctrine)
- #890 [A4-09] History flush recursively creates a nonexistent HOME tree
- #950 stdin feeder: tracked (history/alias) arm does not stop on a parse error — reads past the batch and exits 0
- #956 $- lacks H (histexpand) in interactive -c/script forms; the stdin REPL form carries it
- #971 关闭 Windows Terminal 标签页时，本次会话历史不写入 `~/.niubash_history`

#### Git & doctor (3)

- #842 git-prompt invalidation is Windows-only — unix cached git segment can go stale
- #1049 niugit如何被外部使用？
- #1052 随包 1.5.0 全新装 winuxcmd\bin 缺 git：打包清扫漏掉预装根 bin（#1049 分立单）

#### CI & tests (11)

- #827 [CI] 交互式 PTY 门禁：全平台必跑（现仅 Windows 跑全量 test，Unix 仅 check+lib 信息项，Android 从不跑）
- #953 [test] plugin-source fixture zoo: after-load call chains (bash-preexec hooks, fzf-git widgets, complete-alias wrapper)
- #960 CI 基线红：host_contract alias 测试断言 stderr 恒空，与无 TTY 交互 shell 的 job-control 警告冲突（master 同红）
- #965 [test] bash-preexec fixture never wires its preexec runner (upstream installs the invocation path at load)
- #966 [test] fzf-git.sh / complete-alias fixtures are no-op stubs: chains can prove execution, never output
- #978 test hygiene: lib test 目标 -D warnings 既有 11 处 lint 清零（基底 e6fc93f8）
- #1028 [test] issue993 doc-content pin fails on Windows checkouts (CRLF vs \\n-spanning assert), masked by issue683 fail-fast
- #1033 [CI] build-and-test 不跑 niubash-runtime lib 套件：14 个 doctor 单测只由 X299 腿覆盖
- #1034 [test-gap] 「未设 + Git for Windows 在场」面须在有 Git for Windows 的真机上活体验证
- #1035 [clippy] Linux-only drop_non_drop: ctrl_c.rs:926/:928 drop(watch) on ForegroundWatch without Drop
- #1040 [test] shell::tests::bash_ps0_runs_before_interactive_command fails: PS0 expansion does not set STARSHIP_START_TIME

#### Performance (3)

- #839 resolve_dynamic values_from_command subprocess: silent None on every failure shape and no timeout — a hanging tool freezes the TAB keypath
- #847 Windows wait_with_timeout treats WAIT_FAILED as finished — unbounded wait + permanently dead git-prompt refresh
- #879 [perf-budget] 5 bash-it themes hard-fail by TIMEOUT (no completed rep) — adjudicate harness vs product hang before the gate's veto is restored

#### Documentation (2)

- #963 [docs] pointer from niu test docs to the eco manual-run list (companion to rubash#2910)
- #1031 Claude Code silently runs Git Bash instead of niu when CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH names no file or Git for Windows is installed (backslash collapse, path conversion); doctor row + docs fix

#### Build, packaging & updates (4)

- #997 能否支持scoop安装？
- #999 [build][windows-gnu] Cross-compile link of niu.exe fails: mingw ld export ordinal too large: 87895 (--export-all-symbols)
- #1008 [build] main() comment still says non-Windows cross-build is unsupported after #1007
- #1013 self-update 闪退

#### Other (6)

- #792 关于落实修复全部Bug工作并统筹推进v1.5.0超大杯牙膏挤爆超级无敌版本发布前各项准备事宜的最终确认与进度追踪综合议题
- #863 [1.5.1 charter] 换用 rubash 新 API + 清除 niu 侧手接线/桥接
- #984 Similar problems as gash
- #988 编辑器路执行期形：命令执行中收到 SIGHUP 不信号死，命令跑完后以命令状态平直退出（GNU 等待中即信号死）
- #995 反斜杠被吞掉
- #1060 [bug] 单引号包裹的数组元素仍被花括号展开拆分：'X{16,}Y' → X16Y / XY

---

**Appendix — ruline (bundled via pin `4d0aefa8`): 24 issues closed in the window (2026-11-03 – 11-22)**

ruline ships inside niubash via the pin and has no release of its own; its window closures are listed here (mechanical classification, one group per issue; titles verbatim):

#### isearch (3)

- unixwin/ruline#41 [A6-F16] With a draft typed, Up/Down become prefix search instead of history walk (design decision)
- unixwin/ruline#52 [isearch] 反向搜索四面与 GNU readline 分岔：Esc 丢行 / needle 失效丢匹配 / 接受后历史失同步 / 退出执行丢命令
- unixwin/ruline#60 isearch 搜索态独立移动事件（Right/Left/ToStart/ToEnd、C-f）仍 Inapplicable

#### Undo & history (4)

- unixwin/ruline#32 [A6-F03] Undo grouping diverges: insert runs break at whitespace, backspace runs coalesce
- unixwin/ruline#38 [A6-F11] FileBackedHistory silently drops consecutive duplicates (documented policy — decision)
- unixwin/ruline#53 [undo] revert-line / undo 越过历史召回边界：召回行被整体清空
- unixwin/ruline#57 [undo] 历史遍历不保存逐条目 undo 列表：编辑过的条目跳回后 C-_ 应恢复离开前的撤销点

#### Word & character semantics (4)

- unixwin/ruline#31 [A6-F02] Emacs word flavor is UAX #29 segmentation, not GNU's alphanumeric word set
- unixwin/ruline#40 [A6-F15] transpose-chars swaps grapheme clusters; GNU swaps characters (decision)
- unixwin/ruline#42 [A6-F17] cw on whitespace deletes the whole following word; GNU changes only the gap
- unixwin/ruline#46 [#31 残面] Alphabetic 词扫描的分解字形边缘：run 末尾组合记号的落点

#### Editing operators & motions (7)

- unixwin/ruline#33 [A6-F05] dj/dk at the buffer edge delete the current line instead of failing
- unixwin/ruline#35 [A6-F07] ';' after a till (t/T) can never advance
- unixwin/ruline#39 [A6-F14] Repeating yank-last-arg (M-.) blanks the yanked text
- unixwin/ruline#43 [A6-F18] Dot-repeat replays the operator but drops the inserted text
- unixwin/ruline#48 [#47 残面] cj/ck 在缓冲区边缘仍进入 insert：motion 失败需事件级传回 operator 解析层
- unixwin/ruline#49 [#47 残面] #43 insert 会话捕获未覆盖 Ctrl-W 折算与提交结束的会话
- unixwin/ruline#50 [#47 残面] dot 重放 R 会话走普通插入而非 overstrike

#### Keys & events (2)

- unixwin/ruline#37 [A6-F10] C-x C-r (re-read-init-file) missing entirely — no ReedlineEvent
- unixwin/ruline#45 [#37 残面] 增量搜索中 C-x C-r：引擎 declines，GNU 结束搜索并派发 re-read-init-file

#### Build, ABI & tests (2)

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/bd5435324628c22d9b5e32597613e086c08afe6f) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v16.0.3
body:
## Critical fix

- **The OMP hook works with the server runtime** (#6367, thanks @flipcyde101, closes #6366 reported by @walynde). When `CLAUDE_MEM_RUNTIME` was `server` or `server-beta`, the OMP hook still sent everything to the local worker, so OMP sessions were dropped. The hook now reads `CLAUDE_MEM_SERVER_URL`, `CLAUDE_MEM_SERVER_API_KEY` and `CLAUDE_MEM_SERVER_PROJECT_ID` (or the `CLAUDE_MEM_SERVER_BETA_*` names; environment variables win over `settings.json`) and talks to the server's `/v1` API directly: session start, tool and reply events, context, and session end. It applies the same rules the worker applies before it saves anything: `<private>` blocks are stripped, excluded projects and `CLAUDE_MEM_SKIP_TOOLS` are honored, every prompt is recorded, and the project name comes from git. If the server settings are incomplete, it falls back to the worker as before.
- **OMP users: run `npx claude-mem install --ide omp` once to get this fix.** The OMP hook is a copied file, so a plugin update alone does not replace it.

## Fixes

- **Knowledge queries and corpus requests can no longer hang forever** (#6368, thanks @flipcyde101, closes #6364 reported by @soarkit). A stalled Agent SDK stream used to keep the request and its Claude CLI child alive with no end. A knowledge query or prime now stops after 10 minutes and a corpus request after 15, with a 504 error. The corpus stays locked until the timed-out work has really stopped, so it cannot write after a delete or rebuild.
- **The "paused saving memories" notice goes away once Codex is saving** (#6374, thanks @ryrenz, closes #6372 reported by @raw34). After you switched `CLAUDE_MEM_PROVIDER` to `codex` following a Claude quota pause, every new session still said capture was paused until the old Claude cooldown ran out. The notice is now recomputed when Codex stores a memory.
- **`server api-key create --scope` with no value is refused** (#6375, thanks @ryrenz, closes #6373 reported by @soarkit). It used to create a key scoped to the literal string `true`, which every request then rejected. A bare `--scope`, `--name`, `--team` or `--project` now prints `--<flag> requires a value` and exits 1 without writing anything, on both `create` and `migrate-scopes`.
- **The Agent Cost Report no longer crashes on observations with no model** (#6376, thanks @ZedingZhang, closes #6371 reported by @Realauster). `acr.py rollup` raised a `TypeError` when one window had both a missing model and a named, unpriced one.
- **The Docker server image builds again** (#6386, closes #6379 reported by @InfoALR). It now uses `node:20-trixie`, because tree-sitter 0.26 needs a newer glibc than `node:20` ships.
- **My Work refresh runs on OpenCode 2.x** (#6361, refs #6339 reported by @Realauster). OpenCode 2.x rejects the `--pure` and `--dir` flags, so every refresh step exited 1. The step now checks `opencode --version` and uses each version's own isolation. 2.0.0 to 2.2.2 and 3.x are refused with a reason, because they cannot keep plugins out. On every version the refresh agent now has all tools denied.
- **OMP and Hermes read a worker port saved as a number** (#6363, thanks @chuenchen309). `{"CLAUDE_MEM_WORKER_PORT": 45678}` in `settings.json` used to be ignored, so their requests went to the default port.
- **The OpenClaw installer no longer deletes a folder it did not install** (#6381, thanks @DeryFerd). It ran `rm -rf` on whatever install path `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` named. It now replaces a folder only when it is missing, empty, or holds claude-mem's own OpenClaw manifest. Anything else is left alone with a warning and the default extensions folder is used; if that is also taken by something else, the installer stops.
- **The worker can stop every Claude child it starts** (#6385, thanks @DeryFerd). Field compression and the Telegram wrap-up started their Claude process outside the worker's process list, so a worker that exited hard left them running. They are now on that list, and they do not take a concurrency slot.
- **A CLI stuck printing can't grow the worker's memory without limit** (#6384, thanks @DeryFerd). Output collected from `claude`, `codex`, `gemini` and `opencode` is capped at 128 Mi characters, about 2.5 times the largest real turn measured. Past the cap, the start and end are kept, a warning is logged, and the reply is refused instead of read as a partial answer. Smaller outputs are unchanged.
- **A transcript record with no end can't grow the worker's memory without limit** (#6383, thanks @DeryFerd). A JSONL record over 64 MiB (the largest real record measured was 44 MiB) is skipped, with a warning that names the file, the record's offset and its size. The lines after it are read as normal.
- **The unauthenticated `/v1/info` no longer shows Redis error text** (#6380, thanks @DeryFerd). A queue lane that could not be read used to publish the driver's error, such as a host and port. The reason now stays in the server log.

## New

- **Opt-in CPU cap for chroma-mcp** (#6369, thanks @flipcyde101, partly addresses #6365 reported by @FengJie2004). Set `CLAUDE_MEM_CHROMA_MAX_THREADS` to `2` if chroma-mcp keeps several cores busy. It caps the embedder's threads and, on Linux with `taskset`, the CPUs chroma-mcp can use. It is off by default (`0`), because an always-on cap slowed the first backfill. #6365 stays open.
- **AIGROW preset for the OpenAI-compatible provider** (#6370, thanks @guglielmo-io).

## Hosted sync service

- **The sync services compare their internal projector credential in constant time** (#6382, thanks @DeryFerd). A plain string compare could leak the shared secret through response timing. This changes `services/sync-api` and `services/sync-hub`, which are not part of the npm package: it reaches users only once those services are deployed, not through this release.

## Tests

- A flaky transcript test now counts the append poll's pokes instead of racing its file check (#6360).

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v16.0.2...v16.0.3
